name: datto-saas-protection-mcp
description: MCP server for Datto SaaS Protection - M365/GWS customers, seats, backup status and bulk seat licensing via the documented Datto REST API
long_description: Provides AI assistants with structured access to Datto SaaS Protection through the documented Datto REST API: list protected customers and domains, browse seats and their protection state for Microsoft 365 and Google Workspace, review backup status per application and detailed backup statistics, and license, pause or unlicense seats in bulk (with confirmation).

datto_saas_public_key.title: Datto SaaS Public Key
datto_saas_public_key.description: Public API key from the Datto Partner Portal (Admin > Integrations > API Keys)

datto_saas_secret_key.title: Datto SaaS Secret Key
datto_saas_secret_key.description: Secret API key from the Datto Partner Portal (Admin > Integrations > API Keys)

datto_saas_region.title: Datto SaaS Region
datto_saas_region.description: Deprecated and ignored: Datto has a single API host (api.datto.com)
